## Recently Updated

::: {#recent-notes}
```{=html}
<div id="recent-listing"></div>
```
:::
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

library(yaml)

# Get all literature notes
files <- list.files("literature", pattern = "\\.md$", full.names = TRUE)

# Parse frontmatter and get metadata
notes <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  lines <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
  yaml_end <- which(lines == "---")[2]
  if (is.na(yaml_end)) return(NULL)
  
  yaml_text <- paste(lines[2:(yaml_end-1)], collapse = "\n")
  meta <- tryCatch(yaml.load(yaml_text), error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (is.null(meta) || !isTRUE(meta$publish)) return(NULL)
  
  list(
    title = meta$title,
    date = meta$date,
    categories = meta$categories,
    file = basename(f)
  )
})

notes <- Filter(Negate(is.null), notes)

# Sort by date
notes <- notes[order(sapply(notes, function(x) x$date), decreasing = TRUE)]

# Show top 3
cat("### Recently Updated\n\n")
for (i in 1:min(3, length(notes))) {
  n <- notes[[i]]
  cat(sprintf("- [%s](%s)\n", n$title, gsub("\\.md$", ".html", n$file)))
}

# Group by category
categories <- unique(unlist(lapply(notes, function(x) x$categories)))
categories <- setdiff(categories, c("literature-note", "published"))

for (cat_name in categories) {
  cat_notes <- Filter(function(x) cat_name %in% x$categories, notes)
  if (length(cat_notes) == 0) next
  
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s Papers\n\n", tools::toTitleCase(cat_name)))
  
  for (i in 1:min(10, length(cat_notes))) {
    n <- cat_notes[[i]]
    cat(sprintf("- [%s](%s)\n", n$title, gsub("\\.md$", ".html", n$file)))
  }
  
  if (length(cat_notes) > 10) {
    cat(sprintf("\n[See all %d %s papers →](%s-papers.html)\n", 
                length(cat_notes), cat_name, cat_name))
  }
}
```
